title: Senior QC/R&D
description: Company Description Sika is a speciality chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industrial manufacturing. Sika has subsidiaries in 102 countries around the world and, in over 400 factories, produces innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation sector towards greater environmental compatibility. With more than 34,000 employees, the company generated sales of CHF 11.76 billion in 2024. Job Description Job Purpose Lead the Quality Control and Research and Development functions to ensure consistent product quality, develop and improve construction chemical formulations, and support efficient manufacturing. Drive innovation, cost optimization, and technical problem-solving while ensuring that products meet approved specifications, customer requirements, applicable standards, and Sika’s technical and safety requirements. Key Responsibilities 1. Quality Control and Product Conformity Manage the inspection and testing of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediate products, and finished goods against approved specifications. Establish and maintain sampling plans, testing methods, acceptance criteria, and traceable quality records. Oversee material and finished-product release decisions within delegated authority, ensuring that nonconforming materials are identified, segregated, and controlled. Investigate quality deviations, batch failures, and recurring defects with Production and other relevant functions; verify the effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions. Monitor quality trends and recommend improvements to product consistency, testing reliability, and manufacturing processes. 2. Research and Product Development Lead the development, localization, and improvement of construction chemical products within the assigned portfolio. Translate market needs and customer requirements into defined development projects with Sales, Marketing, and Technical teams. Plan laboratory experiments, performance evaluations, application trials, and stability studies to validate new and modified formulations. Coordinate with Sika’s regional and global R&D teams on technology transfer, technical approvals, and knowledge sharing. Maintain a prioritized development pipeline with clear objectives, responsibilities, milestones, and progress reporting. 3. Raw Materials and Formulation Optimization Evaluate alternative raw materials and suppliers with Procurement to improve supply continuity, product performance, and cost efficiency. Lead formulation optimization initiatives while maintaining required quality, safety, application performance, and shelf life. Ensure that material substitutions and formulation changes are tested, documented, and approved before implementation. Support initiatives to reduce waste and environmental impact, with appropriate technical validation of resulting product claims. 4. Production Support and Industrialization Lead the technical transfer of approved formulations from laboratory trials to pilot and commercial production. Establish manufacturing instructions, process parameters, and quality checkpoints with Production. Support troubleshooting of processing difficulties and product performance issues, identifying sustainable technical solutions. Work with Technical Service and Sales to investigate customer complaints, conduct relevant testing, and recommend corrective actions. Provide technical training on product characteristics, testing requirements, and manufacturing controls. 5. Laboratory Management and Safety Manage laboratory capacity, workloads, equipment, consumables, and testing priorities to support production and development requirements. Ensure that instruments are calibrated, maintained, and suitable for their intended tests. Maintain effective sample identification, retention, storage, and disposal arrangements. Ensure safe laboratory practices, chemical handling, housekeeping, and waste management in coordination with EHS. Maintain reliable and complete experimental records and test results. 6. Quality Systems and Technical Documentation Maintain controlled formulations, specifications, test methods, manufacturing instructions, and technical records. Ensure that approved formulation changes are accurately reflected in bills of materials and relevant systems. Support ISO 9001 requirements and applicable internal, customer, certification, and regulatory audits. Coordinate product testing and certification against applicable Egyptian and international standards. Support accurate product data, safety documentation, and labelling with the responsible functions. Protect confidential formulations, technical information, and intellectual property. 7. People Leadership and Department Management Set objectives, allocate responsibilities, and monitor the performance of QC and R&D employees. Coach and develop the team, assess technical competencies, and maintain training and succession plans. Prepare and control departmental budgets, including testing expenses, equipment requirements, and development resources. Report quality performance, development progress, savings, resource needs, and significant technical risks to management. Maintain effective coordination with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, EHS, Finance, and HR. Qualifications Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Suggested experience: at least eight years in construction chemicals or a closely related manufacturing sector, including three years in a managerial or supervisory role. Demonstrated experience in both formulation development and quality control. Strong knowledge of relevant product technologies, laboratory testing, industrial scale-up, and root-cause analysis. Working knowledge of ISO 9001, applicable product standards, and laboratory safety. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant ERP or laboratory systems; SAP experience is an advantage. Strong communication skills in English and Arabic. Additional Information We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

Proven experience defining product strategy and roadmaps and driving measurable business outcomes across complex product ecosystems. Strong understanding of e-commerce, retail, order management, fulfillment, or post-purchase experiences, including order tracking, modifications, cancellations, returns, and refunds. Demonstrated ability to lead highly complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple business and technology teams, navigating ambiguity and competing priorities. Experience partnering with engineering and architecture teams to build scalable, reliable platforms and modernize legacy technology ecosystems. Strong business acumen with the ability to evaluate guest experience, operational efficiency, financial impact, and return on investment to inform product decisions. Expertise in product discovery, experimentation, analytics, and data-driven decision-making, with a strong ability to define OKRs and measure product success. Strong communication and executive presence, with a proven track record of influencing senior leaders and driving alignment across large enterprise organizations. Expertise in agile product development, including iterative delivery, prioritization, user stories, and working with cross-functional scrum teams. Strategic mindset and bias for action, with the ability to balance long-term product vision with near-term execution and business priorities. Ability to identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, including AI and automation, to improve guest experiences and operational efficiency. Demonstrated ability to mentor product managers, elevate product thinking, and drive strategic influence without formal people management authority. Strong ability to build relationships and collaborate across Digital, Stores, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Guest Services, and Target in India. Processes • Manage the Book of Work, ensuring effective prioritization and alignment with stakeholder timelines. • Oversee and streamline processes related to information controls, productivity, and regional/country enhancements, including workflows and procedures. • Manage the product backlog and collaborate with technology teams to digitize client and internal operational workflows for onboarding. • Review and approve use case scenarios and test cases; coordinate and support user acceptance testing and production verification. • Ensure governance and compliance with all bank risk assessments and policies. • Own and approve CADM data usage and define/manage data access for CADM users; strategize and implement identity and access management applications, ensuring no toxic access. • Collaborate with regional and country digital teams to gather product customizations, facilitate country adoption, and support documentation, guidelines, and training for identity and access management tools. • Collect and analyze data to inform product direction and define enhancements to attract new clients. • Deliver the digital strategy for client channel onboarding, ensuring global scalability while accommodating local requirements. • Act as a people influencer and product owner to deliver proof of concepts and execute incubation ideas across business lines and locations, ensuring governance and controls. • Develop and implement plans to increase awareness of digital transformation within client channel onboarding. • Define and drive training programs to enhance digital automation capabilities among channel operations staff and stakeholders. • Identify and address inefficiencies in channel operations, proposing workflow optimizations. • Leverage data analysis to inform decisions and improve operational metrics. • Identify and mitigate risks in channel operations. • Partner with operations and business units to streamline processes, mitigate risks, and drive efficiencies. • Measure and evaluate outcomes of change initiatives post-implementation. • Assess the impact of process changes to ensure no additional manual touchpoints are introduced. People & Talent The role is not a people leader role however the role involves coordination between multiple parties • Work Closely with channel operations team, business teams, peer product owners, engineering lead, architects to define and implement Solutions. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for successful implementation and deployment of client channel onboarding capabilities • Engage actively with legal and compliance to raise awareness of new product features and secure acceptance of the changes. Governance • Aligning with new Ways of Working Management Standards (nWOWS) • Oversee & track implementation timelines, resolve impediments / blockers, ensure change communication & transition • Good understanding of change management and project management • Identify, analyse, prepare risk mitigation tactics and manage anticipated resistances • Good understanding of ADO dashboard, key metrices and functions Regulatory & Business Conduct • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct. • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct. • Lead to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles. • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters. Key stakeholders • Operations team • IAM team • Business Stakeholders across Cash, Trade, Financial Markets • Channel product owners across Cash, Trade, Financial Markets • Technology team • DCS management team • Agile Coach Skills and Experience • Strong business and product expertise on user entitlements and client onboarding • Product Owner experience • Understanding of product development lifecycle • Strong project management and planning skills, including organizational & time management skills • Clarity of communication style and ability to face off against senior stakeholders • Digital Transformation Qualifications • Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in banking, with a strong focus on managing digital channels; experience in Fintech environments is highly desirable. • At least 5 years of hands-on experience in identity and access management or channel onboarding, preferably within corporate or wholesale banking. • Demonstrated expertise in product ownership, with a strong customer-centric mindset and the ability to effectively communicate with technical, business, and client-facing teams; MBA or commercially focused qualifications are a plus. • Experience managing and collaborating with cross-border and cross-functional teams. • Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to strategize and drive Book of Work initiatives in partnership with other Product Owners. title: Sr Engr Cslt-Data Science
description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. The AI and Analytics Organization is a center of excellence supporting the Verizon Consumer Group in building data-driven experiences for customers and internal teams. You'll work closely with Business Stakeholders, Data Scientists, Data Engineers to design and deliver agentic analytics solutions that generate substantial, measurable value for the business. What You’ll Be Doing... You will be the analytics and semantic layer expert for VCG — someone who investigates business problems first, then builds the governed data infrastructure that makes those answers repeatable and scalable. You will translate complex consumer business questions into insights, and then into reliable, reusable LookML models that power both self-service dashboards and natural-language query interfaces. As the team expands into intelligent, automated analytics workflows, you will help shape how those workflows are grounded in accurate, governed data. You are expected to form hypotheses, conduct analysis, interpret results, and communicate findings — and then productize those findings into governed, scalable data models. If your career has been spent building dashboards to others' specifications, this role is not the right fit. Responsibilities Include Analytics & Insight Generation: Independently investigate business questions such as conversion rates, customer engagement patterns, operational efficiency opportunities using SQL, statistical methods, and exploratory data analysis. Form hypotheses, validate them against data, and synthesize findings into actionable recommendations for business stakeholders and senior leadership. Semantic Layer Development & Metric Centralization: Build, govern, and optimize enterprise-grade LookML models that centralize KPIs across multi-channel consumer touchpoints into a single source of truth. Translate validated business metrics into reusable Explores, derived tables, and standardized definitions that serve dashboards, automated pipelines, and AI-assisted query interfaces alike. Conversational Analytics: Design and deliver natural-language query experiences grounded in the governed semantic layer, ensure the semantic layer functions reliably as the data backbone for conversational AI capabilities and LLM-assisted query tools. SQL & Data Modeling: Author high-performance SQL for complex, large-scale consumer datasets in BigQuery. Build and maintain scalable data models that unify disparate data sources and support both exploratory analysis and production reporting. Implement data validation procedures to ensure model accuracy and reliability. Visualization & Executive Reporting: Create interactive dashboards and visualizations in Looker that translate your own analytical outputs into actionable business insight. Build executive-ready views, monitor deployed models and dashboards, identify and resolve issues proactively. Agentic Workflow Contribution: Contribute to the design of automated analytical pipelines, understand how governed semantic layers enable reliable, auditable AI-generated insights and participate in building that infrastructure. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with business stakeholders to frame analytical questions around dual sales-and-service outcomes. Translate consumer behavior, churn, conversion, and revenue questions into scalable analytical products. Communicate technical findings effectively to non-technical audiences, including senior leadership. What We’re Looking For... You are an analyst at your core who has developed strong data engineering instincts. You start with a question, dig into the data to answer it, and then build infrastructure that makes that answer reproducible at scale. You are as comfortable presenting a finding to a VP as you are optimizing a derived table in LookML. You'll Need To Have Bachelor's degree and four or more years of relevant work experience. Six or more years of experience in an analytics role. Analytics Engineering or Applied AI roles with demonstrated analytical ownership are also relevant. Demonstrated ability to independently investigate and answer complex business questions using SQL, statistical reasoning, and structured analysis. Deep expertise in LookML development (Explores, derived tables, liquid parameters) and structuring validated business logic into standardized semantic layers. Experience building and delivering conversational or natural-language analytics interfaces. Hands-on experience with BigQuery and high-performance SQL for large-scale consumer datasets. Exposure to AI/LLM tooling — including prompt engineering, function calling, and connecting language models to structured data sources. Experience building interactive visualizations and self-service dashboards in Looker or similar BI platforms, where the content reflects your own analytical judgment. Even better if you have one or more of the following: Prior exposure to telecom, subscription services, or consumer technology analytics — particularly around churn, ARPU, and subscriber metrics. Experience with agentic analytics workflows — building or contributing to multi-step, automated analytical pipelines where LLM agents execute queries, perform root-cause analysis, or synthesize insights with minimal human intervention. Experience with Google Cloud Platform. A track record of presenting analytical findings directly to business leadership — owning the narrative from raw data through strategic recommendation. Familiarity with dashboard design principles and visual science. Why Verizon? Verizon is committed to maintaining a Total Rewards package which is competitive, valued by our employees, and differentiates us as an Employer of Choice. We are a ‘pay for performance’ company and your contribution is rewarded through competitive salaries and performance-based incentives. We create an opportunity for us all to share in the success of Verizon and the value we help to create through this broad-based discretionary equity award program. Your benefits are market competitive and delivered by some of the best providers. You are provided with a full spectrum of health and wellbeing resources, including a first in-class Employee Assistance Program, to empower you to make positive health decisions. We offer generous paid time off benefits to help you manage your work life balance and opportunities for flexible working arrangements*. Verizon provides training and development for all levels, to help you enhance your skills and develop your career, from funding towards education assistance, award-winning training, online development tools and access to industry research. You will be able to take part in volunteering opportunities as part of our environmental, community and sustainability commitment. Your benefits package will vary depending on the country in which you work. subject to business approval If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Associate, Credit Portfolio Management, Risk Management Group
description: Job Purpose Lead and enhance the credit portfolio management framework for Consumer Banking Gold Loan product. Partner with Credit Risk and cross-functional teams to translate policy, regulatory and portfolio requirements into effective system controls, operating processes, monitoring frameworks and management insights. Drive the timely delivery of business, technology, audit, compliance and user acceptance testing initiatives, while safeguarding portfolio quality, customer experience and adherence to the Bank’s risk appetite. Key Accountabilities and Requirements: Monitor portfolio performance and provide early-warning insights across originations, exposure, delinquency, non-performing assets, concentration, renewals and collateral-related indicators. Oversee the implementation and governance of credit policies, including product parameters, bureau-score thresholds, loan-to-value limits, appraisal requirements, eligibility criteria, renewal rules and delegation-of-authority controls. Coordinate change initiatives from requirement definition through user acceptance testing, defect resolution, production implementation and post-deployment validation across LOS and connected platforms. Prepare clear, evidence-based portfolio reviews, risk assessments, management updates, committee materials and responses for regulatory, compliance and audit reviews. Build effective partnerships across Credit Risk, Credit Administration, Business, Operations & Technology, Platform, Compliance, Legal, Audit and regional teams. Key Responsibilities Analyse portfolio trends across products, geographies, branches, customer segments, exposure, delinquency and collateral parameters; identify emerging risks and recommend appropriate actions. Validate the configuration and calculation of credit rules within origination and eligibility systems, including bureau-score thresholds, product selection, multipliers, loan-to-value limits, appraisal triggers, renewal eligibility and mandatory-document controls. Translate policy and business requirements into clear business requirement documents, user stories and acceptance criteria, with end-to-end traceability through testing, approval and production implementation. Plan and execute user acceptance testing, document outcomes, prioritise defects, coordinate remediation and validate deployed solutions within agreed timelines. Review manual overrides, data-quality issues and control exceptions; conduct root-cause analysis and recommend appropriate system validations, maker-checker controls, workflow enhancements or targeted communications. Support the implementation of RBI requirements and internal policies applicable to lending against gold collateral, ensuring that complete evidence is maintained for assurance reviews. Provide concise, decision-ready updates to senior management, clearly outlining ownership, progress, dependencies, risk implications, target dates and closure evidence. Develop periodic communications and training inputs for branches to strengthen policy awareness, data quality, repayment-date communication and process adherence. Maintain comprehensive governance records, including approvals, test results, screenshots, documented decisions, circular references and final configuration evidence. Required Experience: 4 - 7 years of relevant experience in retail or consumer credit risk, credit portfolio management, lending operations, product risk, business analysis or credit-system implementation. Experience in secured lending or gold loans will be an advantage. Demonstrated experience in portfolio analytics, policy implementation, user acceptance testing, defect management, control testing and senior-management reporting. Good understanding of Indian retail-lending regulations and internal governance standards. Exposure to regulatory, compliance, audit or risk-assurance reviews is preferred. Proven ability to collaborate across functions and drive timely closure of deliverables involving multiple stakeholders. Education Graduate / Post graduate in relevant field. Core Competencies Strong analytical capability, sound judgement and attention to detail. High level of ownership, execution discipline and ability to manage competing priorities within committed timelines. Clear written and verbal communication, including effective escalation and concise updates for senior stakeholders. Ability to influence and collaborate across Business, Risk, Operations and Technology teams. Customer-focused approach to risk management, balancing effective controls with efficient and positive customer outcomes. High standards of integrity, documentation and evidence-based decision-making. Technical Competencies Hands-on experience in credit portfolio analysis, including delinquency and vintage trends, flow rates, roll rates, non-performing assets, exposure, concentration, exceptions and early-warning indicators.
